resources.string: Frog Companion: send copies to Mac
Sends what you copy to your Mac

When you copy something, including a code you tap in an authenticator app, Frog Companion sends it to your paired Mac over your own Wi-Fi or Bluetooth, end-to-end encrypted.\n\nTo notice a copy, it looks only for Copy buttons, \"Copied\" messages and the system clipboard preview. It does not read, store or send anything else on your screen, and nothing goes to any server.
